params.body:
A new office page, **Verkennen** (`/verkennen`), to browse everything the tool holds by type, project, person and period, with a printable summary and a CSV of the current selection. Made for a facilitator at a table with GLK, on a laptop or a tablet.

## What it shows

One list, newest first, built from two sources:

- **Bouwsoft**, through the nightly reference sync (`reference_bookings`): hours, machines and material booked per project and person. Codes become names via the synced catalogue and staff list.
- **The app**: spoken worksheet lines (with hours and what was done) and the signals the crew raised, each linking to its worksheet.

A worker linked to the staff list on /ploeg is the same person in both sources, under the staff list's name.

## How to use it

- Type toggles (Uren, Machines, Materiaal, Werkfiches, Signalen) with counts; project and person pickers; from/until dates with 7/30/90-day shortcuts; free-text search over project, person, machine, material and what was done.
- Click a project in the list or in the side panel to open it: who worked there, which machines and material, how many days, first and last record.
- The side panel counts the selection per week, per project and per person; clicking a person filters on them.
- Every filter is in the URL, so a selection can be reopened or sent.

## Export

- **Afdrukken of PDF** opens `/verkennen/afdruk` with the same query string: a summary laid out for A4 (totals per type, per week, people, machines, material, then the first 300 records by day). The browser's own "save as PDF" makes the document, so no PDF library is added to the server.
- **CSV** (`/verkennen/csv`) carries every row of the selection, semicolon-separated with a BOM so Excel opens it as UTF-8.

## Limits worth knowing

- The costing carries no quantities, prices or hours: the sync keeps only who, where, what and when. A Bouwsoft record here is one booking, and the printout says so.
- Bouwsoft history reaches back 70 days (`ReferenceSync::BOOKING_DAYS`); the page says how far it actually reaches.
- Read only, behind the existing office login. The facilitator needs an office account.

Also: the office header and page padding now wrap on a phone instead of running off the side.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/ExploreTest.php`: merging both sources, names for codes, each filter, the summary, the login, the Livewire page (toggle, open project, search), and the printout and CSV carrying the selection. Full suite 200/200, pint clean. Checked by hand against a local database with sample data at 1280 px and 390 px wide, and a PDF of a project printed to four A4 pages.

After merge: nothing to run. The page fills from the data the nightly sync already brings in.
params.title: Verkennen: browse the data by type, project, person and period, with a printout and a CSV
